baseDependencies.resolver: Original citation and resource IDs resolve only against the exact selected immutable input graph; no copied rights grant or identity admission.

foodProfileEdgesResolved.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM resolved_edges WHERE subject_type IN ('urn:offmenu:type:FoodConcept','urn:offmenu:type:FoodPreparation')

foodProfileMetricContextPaths.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM resolved_edges f JOIN resolved_edges m ON f.object=m.subject WHERE f.subject_type IN ('urn:offmenu:type:FoodConcept','urn:offmenu:type:FoodPreparation') AND m.subject_type='urn:offmenu:type:FoodCompositionObservation' AND m.has_context=1

foodProfileMetricPaths.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM resolved_edges f JOIN resolved_edges m ON f.object=m.subject WHERE f.subject_type IN ('urn:offmenu:type:FoodConcept','urn:offmenu:type:FoodPreparation') AND m.subject_type='urn:offmenu:type:FoodCompositionObservation'

foodsWithMetricContext.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.subject) FROM resolved_edges f JOIN resolved_edges m ON f.object=m.subject WHERE f.subject_type IN ('urn:offmenu:type:FoodConcept','urn:offmenu:type:FoodPreparation') AND m.subject_type='urn:offmenu:type:FoodCompositionObservation' AND m.has_context=1

profileMetricContextJoins.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM resolved_edges WHERE subject_type='urn:offmenu:type:FoodCompositionObservation' AND has_context=1

unresolvedOrIncompatibleStructuralEdges.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM edges)-(SELECT count(*) FROM resolved_edges)
